notes: Colon can now be your phone's assistant: set it under Default apps > Assist & voice input and long-press Home to talk hands-free. Say or type phone commands like "open WhatsApp", "torch on", "volume up", "set an alarm for 6:30", "call 0803..." (you tap Call) or "navigate to Ikeja". The sidebar is tidier: Saved, History, Settings and Help moved to your profile menu.

browser.notes: Released alongside Colon AI 0.18.0. No changes to the browser itself.
